items.html: It thus follows that two kinds of milk will expand through this channel, which is the Hei of Elokim, and both of them must be found hinted at in this letter Hei. And it is, that there is the aspect of filling and there is the aspect of form. For when you fill this Hei with the three kinds of fillings, whose mnemonic is YH'A — as is known, and they are Hei-Yud, Hei-Hei, Hei-Aleph — they are in gematria El. And with the three collectors they are thirty-four, and with the letter Hei itself they are thirty-nine. And the totality of all together, or the totality of the Hei itself, is forty, like the count of milk (chalav).
